tips: A parry pressed just after a hit still counts - you have a few ticks of grace.
Executes can be parried, but only inside a very tight window.
Ghosts are silent. Watch corners; listen for lunges, not footsteps.
Being parried staggers you. Back off - you're a free cut.
Reflex Tempo builds from parries, not movement. Let them come.
In CTF the flag carrier can't strike. Escort them - they have a dash.
Faction Clash: hold the zone alone. A contested zone scores nothing.
Shroud breaks the moment you strike. Make the first cut count.
Press F8 any time to send feedback with the last 30 seconds as a replay.
Kill-trades go to the higher resource meter. Stay topped up.
Shadow pockets on the Derelict Wreck cut how far anyone can see you.
